stories.headline: Anthropic to pay Akamai $11.6 billion over seven years in cloud deal
stories.dek: Anthropic has committed $11.6 billion over seven years to Akamai's cloud infrastructure, a bet on CPUs that could grow to about $20 billion, and in an unusual arrangement, Akamai is giving Anthropic a potential stake of up to 5% of its stock that grows as Anthropic spends more.

stories.headline: This Browser Extension Lets You Snooze Open Tabs Until Later
